data.one_liner: A bottom navigation bar and tabulation system using Navigator for switching tabs.
data.what_it_does: Bart provides a bottom navigation bar solution supporting inner routing inside tabs, parent routing, and state caching. It includes Material and Cupertino themes with automatic switching.
use_when: You need a bottom navigation bar with inner routing per tab
You require tab state caching and persistence
You want support for both Material and Cupertino bottom bar styles
avoid_when: Your app does not use a tab-based navigation layout
You are using a package that conflicts with material_ui and cupertino_ui requirements
strengths: Supports both Material and Cupertino themes with automatic switching
Provides animated show/hide for both AppBar and bottom bar
weaknesses: Requires specific usage of the material_ui and cupertino_ui packages rather than standard flutter Material widgets
Minimum constraints require Dart 3.12 / Flutter 3.44 or newer
data.setup_notes: Requires adding bart and material_ui dependencies and importing material_ui instead of standard flutter material.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: For official and robust declarative routing including shell routes for bottom navigation.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: For code-generation based robust routing and nested tabs.

alternatives.name: beamer
alternatives.why_pick_it: For URI-based routing and delegate navigation.
